label: early original-phase steps (t=1-3), mostly when input is k/n/p/o/2/l/h/r
explanation: Update-gate unit that fires almost only in the original (input) phase at positions 1-3. About 98% of activation mass falls on t=1..3 (53% at t=2, 40% at t=3). It never fires at t=0 or at t>=5, and is almost silent at the delimiter and in the copy phase (2% of mass). Within that window, which input token is present matters a lot: k, n, p, o, 2, l, h and r have the highest rates (10-17% vs a 5% base rate), and previous tokens g, y, q, c raise the rate further. The strongest activations are k/n/p at t=2 or 3 right after g or y (e.g. 0 g [k]). Fires mostly on the first occurrence of a token (95% of mass) and slightly more often in short sequences. Position alone gives about 97% recall but only 21% precision. The token set raises precision to about 0.53, but the token dependence is graded rather than a crisp set, so the predicate is incomplete.
